title: Herrega Bu'uuraa 1
text: Lakkoofsi 5 fi lakkoofsi 3 walitti dabaluun meeqa fidu?

title: Dubbisuu fi Hubachuu 2
text: Aadde Abeebee qabeenii loon afur qabdi. Loon lama dabalata bitate.
question: Gaaffii: Amma addee Abeebee loon meeqa qabdi?

title: Herrega Hirisuu 3
text: Yoo haguuyyuun quba harka 10 irraa 4 hirifamu, meeqa hafe?

title: Dubbisuu fi Hubachuu 4
text: Barataan tokko kitaaba Herregaa afur fi kitaaba Afaan Oromoo sadii qaba.
question: Gaaffii: Barataan sun waliigalaan kitaaba meeqa qaba?

title: Bocawwan Bu'uuraa 5
text: Bocni geengoo (circle) baay'ina golaa (corner) meeqa qaba?

title: Dubbisuu fi Hubachuu 6
text: Mukti tokko fuula isaarratti baala sagal qaba ture. Baalli sadii qilleensaan bu'e.
question: Gaaffii: Baalli muktichaa meeqa hafe?

title: Walitti Dabaluu 7
text: Bu'aan herrega 7 + 2 meeqa?

title: Lakkoofsa Walcinaa 8
text: Lakkoofsi 10 fi 12 gidduu jiru isa kam?

title: Dubbisuu fi Hubachuu 9
text: Ijoolleen shan tapha irratti argaman. Ijoolleen afur dabalamaniif.
question: Gaaffii: Waliigalaan ijoolleen taphataa jiran meeqa?

title: Herrega Hirisuu 10
text: Bu'aan hirisuu 8 - 3 meeqa?

title: Dubbisuu fi Hubachuu 11
text: Saanduqa keessa hancufa (pencils) kudhan turan. Sadii itti fayyadamame.
question: Gaaffii: Hancufni saanduqa keessa hafe meeqa?

title: Boca Hammaa 12
text: Rog-sadiin (triangle) baay'ina cinaacha meeqa qaba?

title: Lakkoofsa Lammaffaa 13
text: Lakkoofsi tokkoo hanga kudhanii keessaa isa kamtu guddaa dha?

title: Dubbisuu fi Hubachuu 14
text: Lammaa sanduuqa keessaa apilii shan fuute. Isaan keessaa lama nyaatte.
question: Gaaffii: Apiliin amma hafe meeqa?

title: Herrega Bu'uuraa 15
text: Herregni 6 + 4 deebii maali fida?

title: Dubbisuu fi Hubachuu 16
text: Mana barumsaa keessatti dareen lamaan barattoota kudhan kudhan qabu.
question: Gaaffii: Waliigalaan barattoonni daree lamaanii meeqa?

title: Boca Safartuu 17
text: Rog-afurtuun (rectangle) baay'ina golaa meeqa qaba?

title: Hirisuu Salphaa 18
text: Deebiin 9 - 4 meeqa?

title: Dubbisuu fi Hubachuu 19
text: Tarbaayii keessatti manni fincaanii sadii fi dareen barnootaa torba jiru.
question: Gaaffii: Waliigalaan mana ijaarsichaa meeqa?

title: Walitti Dabaluu 20
text: Lakkoofsi 2 fi 8 yoo walitti dabalaman meeqa ta'u?

title: Lakkoofsa 21
text: Lakkoofsi 15 irraa tokko hirisuun meeqa fida?

title: Dubbisuu fi Hubachuu 22
text: Tulluun fardaa shan qaba. Obboleessi isaa lama dabalate.
question: Gaaffii: Amma fardi meeqa jira?

title: Herrega Bu'uuraa 23
text: Deebiin 4 + 4 meeqa?

title: Hirisuu Salphaa 24
text: Deebiin 10 - 5 meeqa?

title: Dubbisuu fi Hubachuu 25
text: Haati manaaf handhuura margaa sagal qopheessite. Sadii loon nyaatan.
question: Gaaffii: Margi hafe meeqa?

title: Boca Hammaa 26
text: Bocni koonii (cone) boca isa kamiin fakkaata?

title: Walitti Dabaluu 27
text: 1 + 9 meeqa fida?

title: Dubbisuu fi Hubachuu 28
text: Kutaa barnootaa keessatti gabatee gurraacha lama fi gabatee adii tokkotu jira.
question: Gaaffii: Waliigalaan gabateen meeqa?

title: Hirisuu Salphaa 29
text: Deebiin 7 - 2 meeqa?

title: Dubbisuu fi Hubachuu 30
text: Bilisummaan ibsaa afur qaba ture. Lama nannoo biraatti kenne.
question: Gaaffii: Ibsaan Bilisummaa harkaa hafe meeqa?

title: Lakkoofsa Walcinaa 31
text: Lakkoofsi 6 dura kan dhufu isa kam?

title: Dubbisuu fi Hubachuu 32
text: Ganama sa'aa shanirratti aduun baate. Sa'aa sadii booda cume.
question: Gaaffii: Aduun yoom cume? (Sa'aa meeqatti?)

title: Walitti Dabaluu 33
text: 3 + 5 meeqa fida?

title: Hirisuu Salphaa 34
text: Deebiin 6 - 3 meeqa?

title: Dubbisuu fi Hubachuu 35
text: Fayyisaan qalama bifa adii lama fi bifa gurraacha sadii bitate.
question: Gaaffii: Waliigalaan qalamni Fayyisaan bitate meeqa?

title: Lakkoofsa Guddaa fi Xiqqaa 36
text: Lakkoofota armaan gadii keessaa isa kamtu hundarra xiqqaa dha?

title: Dubbisuu fi Hubachuu 37
text: Barsiisaan kitaaba barataa sagal qajeelfamaaf kenne.
question: Gaaffii: Baay'ina kitaabichaa barreessi.

title: Walitti Dabaluu 38
text: 0 fi 7 yoo walitti dabalaman meeqa fida?

title: Hirisuu Salphaa 39
text: Deebiin 4 - 0 meeqa?

title: Dubbisuu fi Hubachuu 40
text: Gabaaf imaluun loon saddeet deemtootaan oofaman. Tokko karaatti gale.
question: Gaaffii: Loon gabaa ga'an meeqa?

title: Boca Safartuu 41
text: Kutaan roga afur qabuufi cinaachisa hundi wal qixaa ta'e maal jedhama?

title: Walitti Dabaluu 42
text: Deebiin 5 + 5 meeqa?

title: Dubbisuu fi Hubachuu 43
text: Obboleewwan afur nyaata nyaatanii pedaaliin daabboo sadii dabalatan.
question: Gaaffii: Waliigalaan daabboo nyaatame meeqa?

title: Hirisuu Salphaa 44
text: Deebiin 8 - 4 meeqa?

title: Dubbisuu fi Hubachuu 45
text: Manni barumsaa keenya balbala gurguddoo sadii qaba.
question: Gaaffii: Baay'ina balbalichaa tarreessi.

title: Lakkoofsa Walcinaa 46
text: Lakkoofsi 8 booda kan dhufu isa kam?

title: Dubbisuu fi Hubachuu 47
text: Fardi tokko marga nyaachaa ture. Fardi biraas itti dabalamee lama ta'an.
question: Gaaffii: Amma fardi meeqa ta'e?

title: Walitti Dabaluu 48
text: Deebiin 2 + 7 meeqa?

title: Dubbisuu fi Hubachuu 49
text: Hiriyoonni shan taphata irratti wal arguu isaaniitiif harka wal qabatan.
question: Gaaffii: Baay'ina hiriyootichaa barreessi.

title: Herrega Xumuraa 50
text: Lakkoofsi 10 irraa 10 yoo hirifamu meeqa hafe?
